subject: Re: Kickoff: BRAC - offline RL from logged interactions
body:
Ulla,

Resourcing and data logistics:

- Staffing: Carmen 70% (research lead), Nikhil 40% (algorithms), Wanjiru 50% (training infra), Rosa 30% (data plumbing).
- Compute: MuJoCo-scale offline runs are cheap; titan-a100 best-effort covers the reproduction. The internal-domain study needs maybe 32 GPUs for two weeks in April - still best-effort territory.
- Data: the logged-interaction datasets live on legacy Corpus, and since the Corpus v2 migration freeze is 2026-08-07 we have the whole summer to migrate - I'm sequencing that after our window closes rather than spending team time on it now.
- Privacy: logged user interactions mean Kofi's review is mandatory before the feasibility study touches real data. Filed today given the 2-3 week SLA; Rosa will run anonymization in parallel.

Daniela
